tool_args.rationale: The pilot responses are short-window positive and the signatures plus branch guidance support a sink-coupled dual-horizon adaptation law. Since the target horizon is 23.3 and current measurements cover only H≤0.48, a slow-horizon discriminating observation is needed before fitting and confirming parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the 5 pilot rows directly to the sink-coupled dual-horizon model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot horizons are at most 0.48, leaving the slow adaptation horizon uncalibrated and the long-horizon reversal ambiguous.
More short-horizon data does not resolve the stated long-horizon identifiability gap.
It is irrelevant to identifying the target law.
